s.en: The bus comes every ten minutes.
I missed the last bus last night.
We will take the bus to the beach tomorrow.
s.ko: 우리는 내일 버스를 타고 해변에 갈 거예요.

s.en: The subway is faster than the bus.
My wife took the subway to the market yesterday.
s.ko: 제 아내는 어제 지하철을 타고 시장에 갔어요.

s.en: The new subway line will open next spring.
s.ko: 새 지하철 노선이 내년 봄에 개통할 거예요.

s.en: The train to the sea leaves at nine.
s.ko: 바다로 가는 기차는 아홉 시에 출발해요.

s.en: We slept on the train last Sunday.
I am going to take the early train.
I buy my ticket at the machine.
My son lost his ticket this morning.
s.ko: 제 아들이 오늘 아침에 표를 잃어버렸어요.

s.en: We will book two tickets for tonight.
s.ko: 우리는 오늘 밤 표 두 장을 예매할 거예요.

s.en: The platform is cold in winter.
We stood on the wrong platform an hour ago.
s.ko: 우리는 한 시간 전에 엉뚱한 승강장에 서 있었어요.

s.en: The train will stop at platform two.
s.ko: 기차는 이 번 승강장에 설 거예요.

s.en: This bus route goes past the hospital.
They changed the bus route last month.
I will look for a shorter route.
s.ko: 저는 더 짧은 길을 찾아볼 거예요.

s.en: The transfer at this station is easy.
I made the transfer at the next stop yesterday.
You will need a transfer to the blue line.
My daughter arrives home at seven.
s.ko: 제 딸은 일곱 시에 집에 도착해요.

s.en: The bus arrived late this morning.
We will arrive at the station by ten.
s.ko: 우리는 열 시까지 역에 도착할 거예요.

s.en: The first train departs at five.
Our bus departed ten minutes ago.
s.ko: 우리 버스는 십 분 전에 출발했어요.

s.en: The train is going to depart soon.
The subway is crowded at eight.
The platform was very crowded yesterday.
The bus will be crowded this evening.
